guitar.notes: Royal Blood is a guitar-less duo; Mike Kerr uses a bass run through octave/distortion pedals to emulate guitar, no traditional guitarist.

tone.target: thick fuzzed rock riff with gritty upper mids and punchy low end
tone.profile: thick fuzzed rock riff with gritty upper mids and punchy low end
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Boost/OD -> Amp (UK 45) -> Cab (UK Vintage 4x12) -> EQ -> Compression/Gate. Designed for raw, punchy riffing.

rig.name: Royal Blood - Out Of The Black - Valeton GP-180
